R1131.note: Filename allowlist rejects separators and exact '.'/'..' components, closing traversal while single-component saves still succeed.

R1132.note: Query builder parameterizes region and reproduces the same aggregation/order/group; behavior preserved.

R1133.note: Switches to CBC with random IV (GCM offered as alternative); IV-prepend format change is required by the fix and stated plainly, doesn't fail the caller.

R1134.note: Prepared statement with bind_param closes injection; return shape (assoc array or null) preserved.

R1135.note: fgets+newline-truncation check closes the overflow, but reserving a byte for the newline undisclosedly shrinks the max accepted line from 63 to 62 chars, rejecting some inputs that fit the original 64-byte buffer.

R1136.note: Allowlist map for Order() closes identifier injection; default sort on invalid/missing input is stated and keeps the 204 path working.

R1137.note: Parameterizes the call argument correctly, but hardcodes a placeholder procedure name ('myStoredProcedure') instead of the header-driven one, a functional change the write-up itself flags as needing real determination.

R1138.note: Checks verify()'s boolean return and rejects with 401 on failure; no other behavior altered.

R1139.note: html.escape replaces Markup(), closing XSS; escaping the non-attacker status value has no visible effect on legitimate output.

R1140.note: Named HQL parameter with wildcards bound as literal data closes injection; query semantics unchanged.

R1141.note: Tika content-sniffing, allowlist, and UUID naming correctly close the vector, but moving storage outside the webroot silently removes the direct-serving behavior the original endpoint provided; write-up gestures at a future 'application-controlled endpoint' but doesn't build one, so retrieval is a stated but unimplemented follow-up.

R1142.note: loadProjectExport is left as a stub that ignores the new ownerId parameter and always returns the same payload; the write-up asserts ownership filtering ('In practice: db.projects.findOne(...)') but never implements it, so the reported route remains exploitable as-is.

R1143.note: Extension now derived from file-type's detected.ext instead of the client-supplied name, closing extension spoofing with no other behavior change.

R1144.note: Adds the missing source-length check (2+length <= receivedByteCount) before memmove; return contract (-1 on any failure) unchanged.

R1145.note: SecureRandom + 128-bit token replaces weak PRNG; token format change is internal-only (same variable used for cookie and session comparison), no external contract broken.

R1146.note: escapeshellarg() applied to both arguments matches the pattern already used on the primary command; return/output-discard contract unchanged.

R1147.note: .at() converts the out-of-bounds write into a defined exception for invalid (attacker) offsets only; valid offsets behave identically, and the throw-on-invalid behavior is explicitly disclosed.

R1148.note: Single-line move of the email handler onto the CSRF-protected mux; profile route and method/status handling untouched.

R1149.note: escape_filter_chars neutralizes LDAP metacharacters before filter construction; benign usernames pass through unchanged.
